title: Spoken Into Being
intro: A figure emerges from sacred history, carrying miracles that defied the natural order. This soul arrived through a single divine command, defended a parent from grave accusations, and departed this world before earthly chains could bind them. The story spans from a humble cradle to the heavens above. Who could this be?
clues: I was sent as a sign and mercy from Allah to the Children of Israel.
My arrival was unlike any before — I came into being by the divine word 'Be!' without an earthly father.
My parent faced cruel slander, but sacred revelation descended to declare their innocence and elevate their station.
As a newborn infant, I astonished those around me by speaking clearly from my cradle to clear my parent's name.
By Allah's permission, I shaped life from lifeless clay, gave sight to the blind, and cured the leper with my touch.
I was raised up to the heavens before harm could touch me, and I shall return to this world before the final Hour arrives.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
